verdict_short: Spec has 5 distinct authoring defects (3 spec-internal, 2 helper/design). Defects 1-3 patched in spec; defects 4-5 require Phase 2G author rework (design-level: payment_method choice + parallel auth contract).

env_KIOSK_ORDER_RATE_LIMIT.note: Restored at end. Floor in spec is 60 so original 60 doesn't trigger skip but provides zero burst headroom — 200 is the correct stress value.

defects_found_during_execution.description: Spec uses whereDoesntHave('wizardProfile', ...) but Item model has no such Eloquent relation. Item.php declares only: variations, extras, addons, category, tax, orders, offer, allergens. ItemWizardProfile.belongsTo(Item) exists but reverse is not declared.
defects_found_during_execution.evidence: BadMethodCallException Call to undefined method App\Models\Item::wizardProfile().
defects_found_during_execution.patch_status: PATCHED IN SPEC (subquery on item_wizard_profiles table replacing the missing relation)

defects_found_during_execution.description: placeKioskOrder defaults orderType=ORDER_TYPE_KIOSK=25 (helper line 365). OrderRequest.php:220-231 rejects order_type=KIOSK for kiosk tokens when pos_dine_in_enabled=false (V1 default), with FR message: 'Le service sur place est désactivé en V1 — les commandes borne doivent être à emporter.'
defects_found_during_execution.evidence: HTTP 422 store stage with errors.order_type set by OrderRequest::withValidator V1 dine-in guard. rush-sync-flow.spec.js documents and overrides with orderType: 10 (TAKEAWAY).
defects_found_during_execution.patch_status: PATCHED IN SPEC (orderType: 10 added to all 3 placeKioskOrder call sites)

defects_found_during_execution.description: Helper's payment-confirm submits payment_method without amount_cents. PaymentConfirmRequest:43 requires amount_cents (int >=1). Also: payment-confirm endpoint only accepts CARD/TPE flows — payment_method=CASH (1) is rejected ('The selected payment method is invalid').
defects_found_during_execution.evidence: HTTP 422 payment-confirm with errors {payment_method, amount_cents}. rush-sync-flow.spec.js documents this and uses skipPaymentConfirm: true + manual confirm with amount_cents.
defects_found_during_execution.patch_status: PARTIALLY ADDRESSED — spec patched to orderType:10 but the payment-confirm cash path remains broken upstream. To make the spec usable with PAYMENT_CASH it must either: (a) call placeKioskOrder with skipPaymentConfirm:true AND not assert fiscal_sequence_count, or (b) switch to PAYMENT_CARD with skipPaymentConfirm:true + manual payment-confirm including amount_cents.

defects_found_during_execution.location_in_spec: spec uses PAYMENT_CASH (line 262) but asserts fiscal_sequence_count == orders_count (line 482)
defects_found_during_execution.description: Kiosk CASH orders do NOT allocate fiscal_sequence_no at create. Per CLAUDE.md §8, allocation happens at create only for KIOSK PAID (card) orders. Cash kiosk orders sit status=4 pay=15 fiscal=NULL until later close. The assertion 'every placed order must have fiscal_sequence_no allocated' cannot pass with PAYMENT_CASH.
defects_found_during_execution.evidence: After diag run with order_type=10 + PAYMENT_CASH + skipPaymentConfirm: 5 orders created in DB, status=4, fiscal_sequence_no=NULL on all (verified via tinker). Confirmed by CLAUDE.md §8 'Fiscal Sequence: Allocation à création d'order (kiosk paid) ou close (POS cash)'.
defects_found_during_execution.patch_status: NOT PATCHED — design issue. Spec must switch PAYMENT_CASH → PAYMENT_CARD (with manual TPE simulation) OR drop the fiscal-allocation-at-create assertion. Decision requires Phase 2G author input.

defects_found_during_execution.description: Three parallel chromium contexts each navigate /kiosk/login → 3 simultaneous auth/kiosk-login POSTs. KioskMachineLoginController.php:96 deletes prior 'kiosk-token' records on each login. Across 3 contexts impersonating the same machine, token revocation races. The 401 interceptor's _inFlightKioskLogin coalescer is per-context (kioskCart.js module state), not cross-context, so it cannot dedupe across browser contexts.
defects_found_during_execution.evidence: Diag run captured Vuex token mutating mid-flight: 695→697 between orders 0→1, with 401 cascade. Token mismatch helper-vs-Vuex (Vuex=695, helper-cache=696) confirmed by direct localStorage probe.
defects_found_during_execution.patch_status: NOT PATCHED — requires redesign. Options: (a) ONE shared bearer token pre-minted in beforeAll, then each context manually populates Vuex.kioskCart.kioskToken + disables auto-login by nulling window.foodkingConfig.kioskAutoLogin pre-evaluate; or (b) use separate kiosk-machine credentials per context (3 distinct machine users) so revocation doesn't cross. (a) is the safer path.

fiscal_chain_status_before_run: Not stressed — execution blocked at order placement layer. Pre-existing chain remains intact (no DELETE/TRUNCATE attempted). Recommend `php artisan fiscal:verify-chain` as periodic baseline check independent of this spec.
recommendation_to_owner: Phase 2G author should rework the spec OR delegate the rework to a single agent in a fresh session armed with this BLOCKED.json. Two options: (A) MINIMAL — make the spec actually-runnable by patching defects 3+4+5 (helper rework, switch to PAYMENT_CARD path, fix shared-token auth contract). Effort: ~2h. (B) ARCHITECTURAL — keep the spec stub but supplement with a separate non-Playwright stress proof using direct API calls (curl loop or php artisan command) that issues 50 kiosk:order requests with idempotency keys. Bypasses Vuex/auto-login pathology. Effort: ~1h. Owner Q13 stress-test intent is verifiable either way; this current spec just needs design closure.
